headline: Bareskrim Polri Questions Budi Arie Over Treason Case Allegations
seoTitle: Budi Arie Questioned in Treason Case
metaDescription: Bareskrim Polri is questioning former Minister Budi Arie and other officials regarding allegations of treason involving the tapping of President Prabowo.
aiSummaryBullets: Bareskrim Polri is conducting examinations regarding an alleged treason case involving the tapping of President Prabowo Subianto.
Former Minister of Communication and Information Budi Arie Setiadi was called for questioning alongside a former aide to Joko Widodo.
The investigation also involves high-ranking officials including former Densus 88 Chief Marthinus Hukom, with six police members already named suspects.
aiContextParagraph: The Directorate of General Crimes of Bareskrim Polri is investigating an alleged treason case linked to the unauthorized surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto. As part of this ongoing inquiry, authorities have called several prominent figures for questioning, including former Minister of Communication and Information Budi Arie Setiadi and Devid Agus Yunanto, a former personal assistant to former President Joko Widodo. Additionally, the scope of the investigation includes other senior officials, such as former Densus 88 chief Commissioner General Marthinus Hukom, who was also summoned by investigators. According to reports, the police have already designated six individuals within the police force as suspects in relation to these activities. While Budi Arie and others have been targeted for witness examinations, officials noted that some individuals have yet to fulfill their summons as the probe continues.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the involvement of high-profile political figures and senior security officials in a sensitive investigation, supported by strong search interest and rapid coverage across five major outlets.
